title: Failure path (AC7) has zero test coverage: mark_failed / sweep_mark_failed never exercised
detail: The required failure-path test (mark_failed → status failed, outcome NULL, Sentry, NO notification) does not exist. Its only triggers — attempt_count=5 or a bad uuid in process_row — are never seeded. sweep_mark_failed is the only new DB operation with zero integration coverage.
recommended_fix: Add an integration test seeding attempt_count=5 (or invalid id): assert summary.failed==1, status 'failed', outcome empty, terminal_reason set, notification_count==0. Confirms §4.6/AD-15 end-to-end.

title: Guarded-update race: only sequential retry tested; 0-row StoodDown path never exercised
detail: No test runs two ticks concurrently, so the AD-14 0-row guarded-update result (second writer's UPDATE matches zero rows → StoodDown) is never observed; stood_down is asserted nowhere. The sequential retry only proves next_attempt_at prevents re-selection, not the atomic claim.
recommended_fix: Add a test where two sweep runs process the same due row (concurrent or forced re-select), asserting exactly one advance (Invited) and one StoodDown, with attempt_count advancing once.

title: Cadence offsets (24/24/48/48h) never asserted; fake clock (now_iso) unused — wrong constants pass all tests
evidence:
reference_checks_sweep_integration_test.gleam:37:
    now_iso: "",
141-149:
fn row_next_attempt_at_present(db: pog.Connection, row_id: String) -> Bool {
  to_bool(test_db.query_text(
    db,
    "SELECT (next_attempt_at IS NOT NULL)::text FROM reference_call WHERE id = '"
      <> row_id
      <> "'",
  ))
}
248:
  row_next_attempt_at_present(db, row_id) |> should.be_true()
sweep.gleam:56-65:
const step_to_co_nudge: Float = 24.0
const step_to_reminder_1: Float = 24.0
const step_to_reminder_2: Float = 48.0
const step_to_terminal: Float = 48.0
detail: Per-step tests exist, but only assert next_attempt_at IS NOT NULL — never the exact +24/+24/+48/+48h advance, and the pinned-clock param (now_iso) is never used (always ""). A wrong increment constant (e.g. 1.0) would pass every test while silently breaking the cadence.
recommended_fix: Assert the exact advance (next_attempt_at_before + interval '24 hours' == next_attempt_at_after) for T0/T+24/T+48/T+96, and use a pinned now_iso for deterministic due-selection in at least one per-step test.

title: awaiting_correction exclusion untested (only objected and taken-over pinned)
detail: Of the three lens-named terminal-respect cases, objected (sticky) and taken-over (skip) are covered; awaiting_correction — excluded by NULL next_attempt_at from the wrong-person route — has no test. Same status-filter mechanism, so low risk, but the named case is unpinned.
recommended_fix: Seed an awaiting_correction row with a past next_attempt_at and assert summary.due==0 and status/attempt_count unchanged.
